Explosive Flesh — Innate Technique (1st level)

You can make your body into a deadly bomb.

Starting at 1st level, you can make any part of you a deadly bomb. You spend cursed energy to remove and throw your body parts. You remove the part as described below. Throwing takes an action:

Attack Cost Action Effect
Tiny(Tooth, Finger, Hair) 1 CE + Con mod HP Free action You throw the body part at a point within 120ft. Creatures within 5 ft make a Dex save. On a failure, they take Xd6 force damage. On a success, they take half.
Small(Ears, Nose) 2 CE + Con mod×half your level HP Bonus action You throw the body part at a point within 100ft. Creatures within 10 ft make a Dex save. On a failure, they take Xd8 force damage and are knocked prone. On a success they take half.
Medium(Hands, Feet) 4 CE + Con mod×level HP Action You throw the body part at a point within 80ft. Creatures within 15 ft make a Dex save. On a failure, they take Xd10 force damage and are knocked prone. On a success, they take half.
Large(Arms, Legs) 6 CE + Con mod×level HP Full Turn Action You throw the body part at a point within 60ft. Creatures within 20 ft make a Dex save. On a failure, they take Xd12 force damage and are knocked prone. On a success, they take half.

After using a limb or body part in an explosion, it will be considered removed (Con mod is treated as min of 1).
The X is your CE modifier. Damage from this technique deals twice as much damage to objects and structures.
